summary: Iteration 90 — post-Phase-3 stabilization: validated the 3 P0 fixes (bundle 404 → accepts franchise_code, PIB strict payout_model labels, /summary payout_model toggle). 8/8 tests pass (6 HTTP integration + 2 PIB PDF strict). Fixed one P0 auth-bypass found during testing — bundles route was using sync-only token verification, which fails across multi-pod deployments because the in-memory otp_store is per-process. Switched to async verification with MongoDB session fallback (matching /franchises pattern). Also discovered a NEW P0 data-integrity bug: routes/bundles.py reads sales from db.sales but the real data lives in db.daily_sales — the bundle manifest's Selected Base/Owner Share/Company Share are therefore always 0 (or negative under profit_share) for any India center. The Single Financial Engine promise is broken for the bundle pathway only; /api/center-accounts/summary continues to read daily_sales correctly. FR-TEST-INDIA restored to revenue_share post-toggle.

critical.issue: Reads sales from db.sales collection (empty for India centers); real data lives in db.daily_sales. Bundle manifest's 'Selected Base', 'Owner Share', 'Company Share' all stuck at 0 for PB-HSR Dec-2025 even though /api/center-accounts/summary correctly shows engine.selected_base=949625.43. Worse: under profit_share, the bundle shows a NEGATIVE base (-392234.82) because expenses are deducted from zero sales. Bundle PDF/manifest is now decoupled from the Single Financial Engine for any India center. Fix: in routes/bundles.py:_resolve_period_data, replace `db.sales.find(...)` with the same daily_sales aggregation routes/center_accounts.py uses (total_sale + sale_pbm + sale_other + swiggy + zomato + doordash + card_idfc + bharat_pay + online_other).

FIXED in this iteration. Was using verify_token_sync() which only checks the per-process in-memory otp_store. With multi-pod / multi-worker setups in preview/prod, requests routed to a pod that did NOT mint the token always got 401. Repro: login on pod A, ~50% of bundle requests landed on pod B → 401. Fixed by switching routes/bundles.py to async verification with MongoDB session fallback (matching the pattern in routes/franchises.py:check_access). Wired set_verify_token_async in server.py.

minor.issue: PB-MGT has country=None and no franchise link. Bundles default to India + 15% owner share which is reasonable, but the bundle never surfaces a warning that the franchise link is missing — manifest just says 'Payout Model: revenue_share' with all-zero figures. Consider surfacing 'franchise: unlinked' in the manifest header for ops clarity.

Response is wrapped as {success: true, summary: {...}}. The review request asserts top-level fields (payout_model / section_heading / base_label) but they're nested under .summary. Either flatten the response OR update the review acceptance criteria. The tests in this iteration access j['summary'] explicitly.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix routes/bundles.py:_resolve_period_data to read sales from db.daily_sales (same aggregation as routes/center_accounts.py:1251 onward) — currently every India-center bundle reports Selected Base / Owner Share / Company Share = 0 (or negative under profit_share). The PDF body and manifest are decoupled from the Single Financial Engine that the rest of the platform uses.

Consider centralizing 'load (sales, expenses, commissions) for (center, period)' into utils/financial_engine.py or a shared loader so bundles, center_accounts, mis, owner_reports never drift on which collection / field-set is canonical.

Optionally consolidate verify_token_sync to also check MongoDB sessions (matches what verify_token_async already does) — would remove the per-route async-or-sync inconsistency. Currently only routes/bundles.py + routes/franchises.py have the async fallback; other sync-only routes (sales_expenses, etc.) still 401 across pods until the user reloads.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bundles.py:96-99 — Wrong collection. `db.sales.find(...)` returns [] for India centers; PB-HSR Dec-2025 has 31 docs in db.daily_sales (verified: total_sale aggregate ~9.5L). This is the single biggest correctness issue right now: the entire bundle PDF + manifest is built from zero sales, then run through the Financial Engine which dutifully reports zeros all the way down.
routes/bundles.py:_require_valid_token (FIXED in this iter) — sync-only token check was a P0 in multi-pod prod (50% 401 on cold pod). Now async-first with mongo fallback + sync second.

routes/center_accounts.py:1910-1913, 1916-1930 — Correctly surfaces payout_model / section_heading / base_label / engine.* directly from engine_payload. Toggle test verifies these flip on POST /api/franchises/update/FR-TEST-INDIA with payout_model=revenue_share|profit_share.

utils/bundle_generator.py:152, 294 — `engine.get('base', engine.get('selected_base', 0))` is correct (fixes the `engine.get('selected_base')` always-zero bug noted in the review). The remaining 0 in the manifest is now solely due to the wrong-collection bug above, NOT this lookup.

utils/pdf_generator.py — PIB strict label tests (test_payout_model_strict_pdf.py) confirm Section 7 heading, Section 8 'Franchise Owner Revenue/Profit Share' row, Section 8B title and 'REVENUE/PROFIT SHARE PAYABLE' label all flip with payout_model. 2/2 pass.

routes/center_accounts.py:1702-1791 — model_word_inline correctly derived from engine_payload.payout_model; payout.reason matches (verified live: 'Revenue Share (142443.81) >= MG (89729.91)' and 'Profit Share (89946.18) >= MG (89729.91)' for the two toggle states).
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/bundles.py (FIX — async verify_token with mongo fallback; await _require_valid_token in all 3 route handlers)

/app/backend/tests/test_iter90_p0_post_phase3.py (NEW — 6 HTTP integration tests: bundles accept franchise_code, unknown→404, payout_model toggle propagates to manifest+summary, PB-PERTH overseas is profit_share)

rca_of_the_issue: Bug #1 review claim (bundles 404 on franchise_code) — VERIFIED FIXED: routes/bundles.py:_resolve_center_code now tries center.code first then franchise_code; unknown returns 404 with explanatory detail. Bug #2 review claim (PIB strict labels) — VERIFIED via pdfminer text extraction in test_payout_model_strict_pdf.py. Bug #3 review claim (summary payout_model toggle) — VERIFIED live: toggling FR-TEST-INDIA from revenue_share to profit_share flips summary.payout_model, summary.section_heading ('REVENUE SHARE CALCULATION' ↔ 'PROFIT SHARE CALCULATION'), summary.base_label, summary.payout.type, and summary.payout.reason ('Revenue Share (142443.81) >= MG' → 'Profit Share (89946.18) >= MG'). NEW BUG (db.sales vs db.daily_sales): routes/bundles.py:97 queries `_db.sales.find({...})` — that collection has 0 docs for PB-HSR 2025-12 while `_db.daily_sales` has 31 docs (total_sale aggregate ~949625). Therefore engine receives sales=0 → revenue_share base = 0 - 5000 (gst) ≈ 0; profit_share base = 0 - 5000 - 20000 (commissions/expenses) = -25000+. Mitigation: copy the daily_sales aggregation from routes/center_accounts.py:1251-1290 (or extract to a shared loader). After that fix, the bundle's manifest Selected Base / Owner Share will match the center-accounts summary engine.
